EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows the characteristic nitro-aromatic pattern: a very strong νs(NO₂) band at 1340 cm⁻¹, an intense out-of-plane/rocking band near 694 cm⁻¹ and an asymmetric/ring-coupled band at 1576 cm⁻¹. Only candidate 1 (Cc1ccc([N+](=O)[O-])[nH]1) contains an aromatic NO₂ group, while none of the other molecules possess a nitro functionality. Additional features (strong C–H stretches at 3115–3166 cm⁻¹, CH₃ stretch at 2947 cm⁻¹, CH₃ deformation at 1467 cm⁻¹ and ring breathing modes at 917 and 843 cm⁻¹) are fully consistent with a methyl-substituted nitro indole ring, supporting candidate 1 as the best match.
